screening_results.reason: Based on NeuroStore record: I1 task-based fMRI is met; I2 instructed emotion regulation (reappraisal) is described in abstract and task instructions; I3 stimuli are visual (IAPS images and alcohol images); I4 sample includes patients and healthy controls with separate group data; I5 analyses include within-task contrasts (e.g., attend vs reappraise mentioned); I6 whole-brain group-level voxelwise analyses with MNI coordinates and 5 peaks reported; I7 reporting of peaks in table satisfied. No exclusion criteria from E1-E5 appear to apply. Some details (e.g., exact contrast definitions in analysis table are interaction between groups) are present: global criterion GLOBAL_E3 at analysis level may exclude the specific analysis, but study as whole meets inclusion criteria.

The record indicates a task-based fMRI study (I1). The abstract describes instructed regulation of amygdala activity via neurofeedback and reports reduced amygdala reactivity to visual stimuli and improved implicit emotion regulation, which supports that an emotion-regulation strategy was instructed (I2) and that visual stimuli were used (I3). Sample criteria are met (I4). The record includes at least one whole-brain group-level GLM with peak coordinates reported (analysis 26996601_analysis_0), satisfying whole-brain evidence (I6) and acceptable reporting (I7). The presence of within-task contrasts related to emotion regulation (I5) is implied by the abstract's report of reduced amygdala reactivity to visual stimuli following neurofeedback, though NeuroStore's extracted analyses list only a between-group parametric modulation during an auditory neurofeedback task; the record does not explicitly list the within-group regulation contrasts but the abstract states within-task effects. Therefore I1–I7 are judged met based on the record, with some uncertainty because the NeuroStore extraction does not show the visual regulation contrasts explicitly.

Record indicates a task-based fMRI study (I1) with an appropriate sample (I4) and reports whole-brain peak coordinates (I6, I7). However, the task does not instruct an emotion-regulation strategy (instructions: rate statements on a visual analogue scale), so I2 is not met. Stimuli are textual statements about schizophrenia vs common cold (word/sentence stimuli), which the inclusion criteria explicitly exclude (I3 not met). The reported contrasts (sch-evaluation > cc-evaluation; correlations with questionnaire scores and extracted mPFC activation) do not represent within-task emotion-regulation contrasts or passive unregulated viewing contrasts (I5 not met). No full-text incompleteness is indicated.

The study reports fMRI of sequential finger movements (motor task) using auditory metronome stimuli and does not involve instructed emotion regulation or visual emotional stimuli. Met inclusion: I1 (task-based fMRI), I4 (sample qualifies), I6 (whole-brain results with peak coordinates reported). Did NOT meet I2 (no emotion regulation instruction), I3 (stimuli are auditory, not visual emotional), and I5 (no within-task emotion-regulation or passive emotional viewing contrasts reported). No full-text exclusion criteria (E1-E5) were triggered by the record.

All full-text inclusion criteria are met based on the NeuroStore record: I1 task-based fMRI (concurrent tDCS-fMRI with an event-related Emotion Regulation Task); I2 instructed emotion regulation (cognitive reappraisal to decrease emotional responses is explicitly instructed); I3 visual stimuli (IAPS photographs); I4 sample includes patients and controls and results reported separately; I5 analyses report within-task regulation and viewing contrasts (e.g., decrease > look, look > decrease); I6 whole-brain group-level voxelwise results are reported (spatial scope: whole brain; coordinates in Talairach); I7 reporting in tables of peaks is present. No full-text exclusion criteria are met.

The NeuroStore record describes a task-based fMRI study (I1) that instructs emotion regulation via arrows (increase, decrease, maintain) consistent with cognitive reappraisal/regulated strategies (I2). Stimuli are visual IAPS pictures (I3). Participant samples (young and older) are acceptable (I4). The record reports within-task contrasts related to regulation and passive viewing (I5). Multiple analyses are described as whole-brain group-level maps with peak coordinates in MNI space (I6) and peaks are reported in tables (I7). No full-text exclusion criteria (E1-E5) are met based on the record.

Record indicates a task-based fMRI study using instructed cognitive reappraisal to down-regulate responses to visual IAPS pictures (meets I1, I2, I3). Participants and analyses are reported (I4). At least one group-level whole-brain voxelwise contrast isolating reappraisal (decrease > look) with MNI coordinates is reported (meets I5, I6 and I7). No exclusion criteria (E1-E5) apply based on the record.

Record indicates a task-based fMRI emotion-regulation experiment using instructed regulation (Diminish/Enhance/Maintain), with visual IAPS picture stimuli, participant groups including PTSD and controls, multiple within-task regulation contrasts reported, and whole-brain group-level results with peak coordinates in MNI. All full-text inclusion criteria I1-I7 are met based on the NeuroStore record. No full-text exclusion criteria (E1-E5) are clearly met from the record.

NeuroStore record indicates this is a resting-state fMRI study (no task or stimuli) that reports ReHo and seed-based functional connectivity and between-group comparisons. It therefore does not meet task-based requirements (I1), has no instructed emotion regulation task (I2), involves no visual emotional stimuli (I3), reports no within-task emotion-regulation or unregulated viewing contrasts (I5), and does not provide task-evoked whole-brain activation maps (I6). Because the study reports only resting-state / connectivity results without task activation maps, it meets exclusion criterion E3.

All full-text inclusion criteria are met based on the NeuroStore record: I1 task-based fMRI (Ultimatum Game); I2 regulation instruction using reappraisal (up- and down-regulation); I3 visual stimuli (pictures of proposers); I4 healthy participant sample reported; I5 within-task contrasts related to regulation and unregulated viewing (reappraise > look, up/down > look); I6 whole-brain group-level results with peak coordinates in MNI; I7 results reported in tables. No full-text exclusion criteria are met.

NeuroStore record indicates a task-based fMRI study (I1) that instructs emotion regulation strategies including cognitive reappraisal and expressive suppression (I2). Stimuli are visual (movies and static images) (I3). Sample is healthy participants reported separately (I4). The paper reports within-task regulation and viewing contrasts (I5). Multiple analyses are explicitly described as whole-brain with reported peak coordinates in Talairach (I6) and peaks are reported in tables (I7). No exclusion criteria from E1–E5 are met based on the record.

The NeuroStore record indicates this is a resting-state fMRI study (Task: Rest Task; continuous design; instructions to relax and forget disturbing events) with between-group comparisons (patients > controls and controls > patients). It does not report a task-based fMRI paradigm with instructed emotion regulation, nor visual emotional stimuli, nor within-task regulation or passive viewing contrasts. Inclusion criteria met: I4 (sample). Inclusion criteria NOT met: I1 (task-based fMRI), I2 (instructed emotion regulation strategy), I3 (visual emotional stimuli), I5 (within-task emotion-regulation or unregulated viewing contrast), I6 (whole-brain task-evoked map — analyses are resting-state). Exclusion criteria met: E3 (resting-state analyses only) and E4 (only between-group contrasts with no within-group task effect).

The NeuroStore record shows this is a task-based fMRI study with instructed cognitive reappraisal of visual IAPS pictures (meets I1, I2, I3), reports healthy participants (I4), and provides whole-brain, voxelwise group results with peak coordinates in Talairach (I6, I7). However, all extracted analyses in the record are described as between-group contrasts or group x condition interactions; the record does not contain any within-group regulation contrasts or unregulated viewing contrasts (I5 not met). This meets exclusion criterion E4 (only between-group contrasts reported).

All full-text inclusion criteria I1-I7 are met: task-based fMRI with instructed reappraisal (I1,I2), visual IAPS pictures as stimuli (I3), acceptable sample (I4), within-task regulation and viewing contrasts reported (I5), several analyses are group-level whole-brain voxelwise maps with reported peak coordinates in MNI space (I6,I7). No full-text exclusion criteria (E1-E5) are met based on the record.

The NeuroStore record shows this is an EEG study (electrophysiological amplitude, sLORETA source estimation) rather than an fMRI study; therefore it fails full-text inclusion criterion I1 (Task-based fMRI study). The record does meet other inclusion criteria: I2 (an emotion regulation strategy was instructed: decrease/increase/maintain), I3 (visual stimuli: IAPS pictures), I4 (sample: healthy participants reported), I5 (reports within-task regulation contrasts, e.g., decrease > maintain), I6 (group-level whole-brain source localization with peak coordinates reported in Talairach), and I7 (results reported with coordinates). No full-text incompleteness is indicated. None of the explicit exclusion criteria E1–E5 apply based on the record.

The NeuroStore record describes a task-based fMRI emotion regulation study using instructed reappraisal of visual (IAPS) images, reports within-group regulation and viewing contrasts (Maintain and Reappraise vs Baseline), and lists whole-brain spatial scope with reported MNI peaks. Although the inference for the listed analysis is 'small-volume corrected; corrected within roi', the record also indicates whole-brain spatial scope and reported peak coordinates in standard space, so I6 is judged met. No full-text exclusion criteria (E1–E5) are triggered by the record.

All full-text inclusion criteria are met based on the NeuroStore record: I1 task-based fMRI (task and BOLD measure reported); I2 reappraisal/antecedent reappraisal strategy (study investigates extrinsic/incidental reappraisal via precedent descriptions); I3 visual stimuli (IAPS and photographs); I4 sample includes healthy participants with reported n and demographics; I5 within-task contrasts related to emotion processing (unpleasant > neutral) are reported; I6 whole-brain group-level voxelwise analyses are reported (analyses 1 and 2, MNI coordinates); I7 peaks reported in tables. No full-text exclusion criteria are met in the record.

The NeuroStore record shows this is a task-based fMRI study using instructed reappraisal of visual IAPS images (meets I1, I2, I3) in a patient sample (meets I4). Whole-brain, group-level maps with reported peak coordinates are present (meets I6 and I7). However, every listed contrast is described as an 'omnibus, between-group' contrast (model terms include remission status, scan time, and their interaction) and the record does not report any within-group regulation or passive viewing contrasts (does not meet I5). Therefore the study appears to report ONLY between-group contrasts/interactions, so exclusion criterion E4 applies.

Record shows a task-based fMRI study with instructed regulation strategies (mindfulness and cognitive reappraisal), visual IAPS stimuli, healthy participants, and at least one whole-brain group-level map reported with peak coordinates (analyses 5–7) — so I1, I2, I3, I4, I6 and I7 are met. However, all analyses in the NeuroStore record are reported as between-group contrasts or interactions (mindfulness vs cognitive control); no within-group task contrasts (e.g. reappraise>view or emotion>neutral within a single group) are present in the record. Therefore inclusion criterion I5 is not met and exclusion criterion E4 (reports ONLY between-group contrasts/interactions with no within-group task effect) applies.

NeuroStore record indicates a task-based fMRI study (I1) that instructs reappraisal-based emotion regulation (I2). The stimuli include visual countdowns (visual stimuli) associated with anticipatory anxiety (I3). Sample and reporting meet inclusion (I4). The record lists within-task regulation and viewing contrasts (I5). Spatial scope is whole-brain with MNI coordinates and reported peaks (I6,I7). No full-text exclusion criteria are met based on the record.

I1 (task-based fMRI), I2 (instructed reappraisal), I3 (visual IAPS stimuli), I4 (healthy participants), and I7 (results reported as coordinate table) are met according to the NeuroStore record. However I5 (at least one within-task, within-group contrast related to regulation or unregulated viewing) is not met: the extracted contrasts are described as group comparisons / an interaction (HM after reappraisal > LM before reappraisal) rather than within-group task effects. I6 (at least one whole-brain group-level voxelwise map) is not supported: the reported inference is Small Volume Correction (pFWE) and no whole-brain analysis is stated. Therefore the record indicates the study reports only between-group interaction contrasts and SVC-corrected peaks with no accompanying whole-brain within-group contrasts, meeting exclusion criteria E1 and E4.

The NeuroStore record shows this is an fMRI emotion-regulation study with IAPS visual stimuli (I1,I2,I3), reports participant groups including patients and controls (I4), and reports whole-brain coordinate results (I6,I7). However, all reported contrasts in the record are described as between-group contrasts or interactions (e.g. 'Controls; Reappraise > UHR; Attend' and 'interaction, between-group'), and the record does not report any within-group task contrasts (e.g. reappraise > view within a group). Therefore full-text inclusion criterion I5 (at least one within-task contrast related to regulation or unregulated viewing) is not met, and the study meets exclusion criterion E4 (reports ONLY between-group contrasts or interactions).

The study investigates acupuncture needling (somatosensory stimulation) not emotion regulation. Full-text inclusion criteria met: I1 (task-based fMRI), I4 (sample qualifies), I6 (whole-brain voxelwise results reported), I7 (coordinates/tables available). Full-text inclusion criteria NOT met: I2 (no instructed emotion regulation strategy), I3 (stimuli are not visual emotional stimuli; they are acupuncture needling), I5 (no within-task contrast related to emotion regulation or passive viewing of emotional stimuli). No full-text incompleteness indicated.

The NeuroStore record describes a task-based fMRI emotion regulation study using instructed detachment (reappraisal/distancing) vs permit, with visual stimuli (IAPS/EmoPicS), healthy participants (n=76), and reports at least one group-level whole-brain voxelwise analysis with MNI coordinates (Analyses 0 and 1). Thus I1-I7 are met based on the record. No full-text exclusion criteria are met.

Record shows a task-based fMRI study (I1) that instructs reappraisal regulation (I2: instruction 'use reappraisal to decrease negative affect'), uses visual stimuli including fearful and neutral faces and sentences (I3), reports results for a healthy adult sample (I4), includes within-task contrasts of regulation and viewing (I5: reappraise > look, look > reappraise, top-down > bottom-up), and provides whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results with coordinates in TAL and cluster correction (I6, I7). No full-text exclusion criteria (E1-E5) are met based on the record.

The NeuroStore record indicates this is a task-based fMRI study of instructed reappraisal with visual IAPS stimuli and whole-brain, corrected group analyses (so I1, I2, I3, I4, I6, I7 are met). However, all listed analyses are labeled as 'omnibus, between-group' contrasts (e.g. 'Maintain > Baseline [omnibus, between-group]', 'Reappraise > Baseline [omnibus, between-group]'), indicating the paper reports between-group contrasts rather than within-group task effects. Thus inclusion criterion I5 (at least one within-task contrast for a group) is not met, and exclusion criterion E4 (reports ONLY between-group contrasts with no within-group task effect) applies.

All full-text inclusion criteria are met based on the NeuroStore record: task-based fMRI with instructed emotion regulation (instructed causal attributions), visual stimuli (faces), appropriate sample (patients and controls reported separately), within-task regulation and viewing contrasts reported, and whole-brain group-level voxelwise maps with coordinates and cluster correction are reported. No full-text exclusion criteria apply.

NeuroStore record indicates resting-state seed-based functional connectivity analyses (seed-based FC between amygdala subnuclei and cortical regions) rather than a task-based fMRI experiment with instructed emotion regulation. Therefore the record does not meet several required full-text inclusion criteria: I1 (task-based fMRI) is not met because Task = Rest Task; I2 (instructed emotion regulation strategy) is not met (no regulation task); I3 (visual emotional stimuli) is not met (no stimulus presentation); I5 (within-task regulation or passive viewing contrasts) is not met (analyses are cross-subject regressions on trait measures, not within-task contrasts); I6 (whole-brain task-evoked voxelwise maps) is not met (Spatial scope: region of interest; seed-based connectivity). The sample inclusion criterion I4 (sample qualifies) is met. Exclusion criteria E2 (ROI-only results with no whole-brain activation map) and E3 (connectivity or resting-state results rather than task activation) apply. fulltext_incomplete set to false.

All full-text inclusion criteria are met based on the NeuroStore record: I1 task-based fMRI (event-related reappraisal task); I2 instructed emotion regulation (reappraise/detach); I3 visual stimuli (IAPS photographs); I4 sample includes healthy younger and older adults with results reported; I5 within-task contrasts related to regulation and passive viewing are reported (Reappraise > Experience; Experience > Reappraise); I6 whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results with coordinates in MNI are reported (tables of peaks); I7 results are described in tables/figures. No full-text exclusion criteria (E1-E5) are met by the record.

Record indicates task-based fMRI with instructed reappraisal (I1, I2), visual stimuli (negative and neutral pictures) (I3), participant samples reported including controls (I4), within-task contrasts related to regulation and unregulated viewing (Decrease Neg > Look Neg, Look Neg > Decrease Neg) (I5), whole-brain group-level voxelwise maps with reported peaks in MNI space (GLOBAL: Spatial scope whole brain; Analyses 2 and 3 report FWE whole-brain inference; others are SVC but at least some whole-brain analyses exist) (I6). Results appear in tables of peaks (I7). No exclusion criteria met.

The NeuroStore record reports a task-based fMRI emotion regulation experiment using instructed reappraisal (Increase and Decrease instructions) with visual stimuli (faces), reports within-group regulation and viewing contrasts, and provides whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results with peak coordinates (AlphaSim-corrected whole-brain, MNI space). All full-text inclusion criteria I1-I7 are met. No full-text exclusion criteria (E1-E5) are met by the record.

The NeuroStore record describes a task-based fMRI study of instructed cognitive reappraisal (I1,I2) using visual stimuli (faces) (I3). Participants are healthy adults with group results reported (I4). The record reports within-task contrasts for regulation and unregulated viewing (I5). Whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results with peak coordinates in MNI are reported (I6,I7). No full-text exclusion criteria are met.

Record describes a task-based fMRI study using instructed cognitive reappraisal (increase and decrease) with visual IAPS pictures, reports within-task regulation and viewing contrasts, and reports whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results (Talairach coordinates, cluster-corrected peaks). Criteria met: I1,I2,I3,I4,I5,I6,I7. No full-text exclusion criteria indicated by the record.

The NeuroStore record shows a task-based fMRI study using visual IAPS stimuli with an eligible sample (meets I1, I3, I4). However, the record does not report any within-group task activation contrasts related to regulation or passive viewing (no reappraise>look or emotion>baseline maps); instead the reported results are predominantly seed-based gPPI connectivity maps and between-group contrasts/interactions. Therefore the study appears to report only connectivity and between-group effects and lacks the required within-task whole-brain activation contrasts (meets exclusion criteria E3 and E4). The presence of an explicitly instructed reappraisal-style regulation (I2) is ambiguous in the record and not clearly stated. Missing inclusion criteria: I2 and I5.

The record describes an fMRI task with instructed emotion regulation (cognitive reappraisal: 'Reduce Emotion' instructions), visual stimuli (24 IAPS images), participants including clinical and control groups with reported within-task contrasts (Reduce > Maintain), and at least one group-level whole-brain analysis with peak coordinates (Analyses 20673804_analysis_2 and 20673804_analysis_3). All full-text inclusion criteria I1–I7 are met. No full-text exclusion criteria (E1–E5) are met.

The NeuroStore record indicates a task-based fMRI study (I1) with an instructed emotion regulation strategy (Reappraise) (I2), visual stimuli (IAPS images) (I3), an acceptable sample including patients and controls with separate reporting (I4), reported within-task contrasts related to regulation and viewing (I5), and whole-brain, group-level voxelwise results with peak coordinates in MNI (I6/I7). No full-text exclusion criteria from the record apply.

NeuroStore record shows this is a task-based fMRI study of instructed emotion regulation using visual IAPS stimuli in healthy participants with within-task contrasts (I1, I2, I3, I4, I5 met). However, all reported analyses are described as region-of-interest results with small-volume correction and no group-level whole-brain (voxelwise) maps or whole-brain coordinate tables are reported in the record, so full-text inclusion criterion I6 is not met. This meets exclusion E2 (ONLY ROI/SVC results reported).

The NeuroStore record describes an fMRI emotion-regulation task with instructed strategies (reappraisal and distraction) using visual IAPS images and an eligible sample (I1, I2, I3, I4 met). However, all extracted analyses are reported as region-of-interest results (Spatial scope: region of interest) rather than whole-brain voxelwise maps (I6 not met), and the listed contrasts are between-group interactions with no within-group regulation or unregulated viewing contrasts evident in the record (I5 not met). Thus full-text exclusion criteria E2 (ONLY ROI results / no whole-brain analysis) and E4 (ONLY between-group contrasts with no within-group task effect reported) apply.

The NeuroStore record indicates this is a resting-state seed-based connectivity study (Task: Rest Task; connectivity method: seed based) comparing OCD patients and healthy controls and relating connectivity to emotion regulation questionnaires. It does not report a task-based fMRI emotion regulation paradigm or within-task regulation contrasts. Full-text inclusion criteria met: I4 (sample criteria). Not met: I1 (not a task-based fMRI study), I2 (no instructed emotion regulation task), I5 (no within-task regulation or unregulated viewing contrasts), I6 (no task-evoked whole-brain group activation maps). Exclusion criteria triggered: E3 (reports only seed-based/resting-state connectivity) and E4 (only between-group contrasts/interactions with no within-group task effect).

Study fails the stimulus modality inclusion criterion: the NeuroStore record indicates the task uses auditory cues (high- and low-pitch beeps) and electrical pain stimulation rather than VISUAL emotional stimuli, so full-text inclusion criterion I3 is not met. Other inclusion criteria met per record: I1 (task-based fMRI), I2 (instructed regulation strategy: self-distraction), I4 (sample acceptable), I5 (within-task regulation and anticipation contrasts reported), I6 (whole-brain group-level voxelwise results with coordinates in MNI), and I7 (coordinates reported). No full-text exclusion criteria from E1–E5 are met based on the record.

I1: Task-based fMRI study (record describes fMRI task with block design). I2: Emotion regulation instructed (cognitive reappraisal instructed during regulate blocks). I3: Stimuli visual (IAPS images). I4: Sample qualifies (healthy participants reported). I5: Analyses report within-task contrasts related to regulation (Reappraisal > view, View > Reappraisal). I6: Whole-brain evidence present: analyses labelled whole brain with voxelwise inference (FDR corrected voxel-level) and reported peak coordinates in Talairach. I7: Coordinates reported in a table. No exclusion criteria appear met; connectivity analysis exists but other whole-brain activation contrasts are present.

NeuroStore record shows this is a task-based fMRI study with visual face stimuli (I1, I3), an appropriate sample (I4), within-task contrasts and cross-subject regressions using ERQ scores (I5), and reported whole-brain voxelwise results/coordinates (I6, I7). However, the record explicitly states the task included 'no instructions to regulate emotion' and the reported analyses are observational associations with self-reported reappraisal (ERQ) rather than instructed emotion regulation conditions. Therefore the study does not meet I2 (an emotion regulation strategy is instructed). No full-text incompleteness is indicated.

Record indicates a task-based fMRI study (I1) instructing reappraisal-style emotion regulation (down- and up-regulate instructions) (I2), using visual stimuli (IAPS and spider pictures) (I3), reporting results for a clinical sample with group-level analyses (I4), containing within-task contrasts for regulation and unregulated viewing (I5), and reporting group-level whole-brain voxelwise results with coordinates in MNI (I6,I7). No full-text exclusion criteria appear to apply.

The NeuroStore record shows an fMRI task with visual stimuli (I1, I3) and an eligible sample (I4). However, the record does not indicate an instructed emotion-regulation strategy such as reappraisal (I2 not met), and it does not report any within-task voxelwise task-activation contrasts or whole-brain task-evoked statistical maps with peak coordinates (I5 and I6 not met). Instead, the reported analyses are seed-based/effective connectivity (Granger) results, so the study meets exclusion criterion E3 (only connectivity results reported without whole-brain activation maps).

The NeuroStore record shows this is a task-based fMRI study using instructed cognitive reappraisal of visual (IAPS) images with whole-brain, coordinate-based results (meets I1, I2, I3, I4, I6, I7). However, all reported analyses in the record are between-group contrasts or Group×Condition interaction effects (e.g. control sad>neutral > rMDD), and the record does not report any within-group task contrasts (e.g. reappraise>view within a group). Therefore inclusion criterion I5 is not met and exclusion criterion E4 (ONLY between-group contrasts/interactions reported) applies.

I1: Task-based fMRI study (Dictator Game task) as per task field. I2: Emotion regulation strategy instructed: explicit reappraisal up- and down-regulation instructions stated in the task description. I3: Visual stimuli: Photographs of male and female proposers. I4: Sample: healthy participants reported with demographics. No fulltext_incomplete. No exclusion criteria met from the NeuroStore record. Some details not explicitly stated in the record (e.g., whether any analyses are only ROI), but the record explicitly states whole brain for multiple analyses.

The NeuroStore record describes a resting-state (fixation cross) seed-based functional connectivity study examining correlations between habitual reappraisal scores and amygdala-centered connectivity. This is NOT a task-based fMRI emotion regulation paradigm with instructed reappraisal of visual emotional stimuli. Therefore several required inclusion criteria are not met (I1: task-based fMRI; I2: instructed emotion regulation strategy; I3: visual emotional stimuli; I5: within-task emotion regulation or unregulated viewing contrast; I6: whole-brain task-evoked statistical activation maps). Additionally, the study explicitly reports only resting-state/seed-based connectivity results, which meets exclusion criterion E3. The participant/sample criterion I4 is met (healthy adults reported).

All full-text inclusion criteria are met based on the NeuroStore record: I1 (task-based fMRI with clear task), I2 (instructed emotion regulation strategies: Detachment, Reinterpretation, Distraction, Expressive Suppression), I3 (visual stimuli: IAPS pictures), I4 (healthy participant sample reported), I5 (within-task regulation and viewing contrasts reported), I6 (group-level whole-brain voxelwise maps with MNI coordinates and FWE correction), I7 (results reported as coordinate tables). No full-text exclusion criteria from E1-E5 are met by the record.

No exclusion criteria (E1-E5) are met.

All full-text inclusion criteria are met by the NeuroStore record: I1 task-based fMRI (Emotion Regulation Task); I2 regulation instruction using cognitive reappraisal (distancing); I3 visual stimuli (negative/neutral pictures); I4 eligible sample (healthy adults, results reported for this group); I5 within-task contrasts related to regulation and unregulated viewing are reported (RegulateNeg > WatchNeg and WatchNeg > RegulateNeg); I6 whole-brain evidence: spatial scope listed as whole brain and peak coordinates reported in MNI; I7 reporting in tables/peaks is present. It reports within-task regulation contrasts (e.g., Increase>Look, Decrease>Look) and group-level whole-brain voxelwise analyses with coordinates in MNI (meets I1-I7). No full-text exclusion criteria are met based on the record.

Met inclusion criteria I1 (task-based fMRI), I2 (instructed emotion regulation via reappraisal), I3 (visual IAPS stimuli), I4 (sample reported), and I5 (within-task regulation and viewing contrasts). Did NOT meet I6: no group-level whole-brain task-evoked activation map is reported in the record (analyses 0 and 1 are ROI-only; analysis 2 is whole-brain but is a PPI connectivity analysis). Record shows a task-based fMRI study of instructed emotion regulation (reappraisal and distraction) using visual IAPS stimuli in clinical and control groups, so I1, I2, I3 and I4 are met. However, all reported analyses in the NeuroStore record are either region-of-interest (ROI) voxelwise results (inference FWE within each ROI) or seed-based PPI connectivity analyses, and the listed contrasts are group x condition interactions (between-group).
